social_circle.name: Mary Chand

demographics.occupation: Retired school office aide and household manager

background.how_they_met: They met as young adults in the Havre-area Native and local community and married more than forty years ago.
background.why_close: Mary is Ellias's primary partner, household anchor, and first emotional support. She helps organize appointments, bills, paperwork, and daily routines while sharing gardening, simple meals, community events, and quiet evenings with him.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Short, practical texts with clear reminders. She uses full sentences, rarely uses slang, and may send a quick note like 'Doctor at 10:30. Bring the blue folder.'

shared_activities: evenings with tea while she reads and he sketches or sorts beads
recent_text_topics: Appointment reminders, medication refills, pharmacy stops, and the big paper calendar they started using after Ellias missed an appointment.
Grocery lists for soup, sourdough, beans, garden produce, and low-salt meals.
Checking whether Ellias should rest his hands after arthritis pain or ask for help with heavier tasks.
Family visit planning for summer, grandchildren, holidays, and community events.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q05 says Ellias is married to Mary Chand, that she is 'the steadier one in the house' and remembers appointments and the checkbook. Q11 says Mary handles bills and laundry while Ellias cooks, gardens, shovels, and fixes things. Q33 and Q44 show Mary helping during his hand flare. Q84 confirms they are married and living together.

social_circle.name: Lena Chand

demographics.education: Associate degree in health information management

background.how_they_met: Lena is Ellias and Mary's adult daughter, raised in their Havre household.
background.why_close: She remains closely connected despite living in Great Falls. Ellias trusts her health care knowledge, talks with her by phone and video, and sees her about monthly.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Efficient and caring. She texts in complete sentences, often sends links or screenshots about appointments and health information, and follows up if Ellias does not answer.

shared_activities: helping with heavy cleaning before visitors
recent_text_topics: Questions about Ellias's blood pressure medication adjustment, salt intake, walking routine, and whether his hand pain has improved.
Helping Mary and Ellias understand clinic paperwork, insurance details, and vaccine or public health information.
Scheduling her next visit from Great Falls and asking what groceries or cleaning help they need.
Sharing grandchildren photos, school updates, and family video call plans.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q05 identifies Lena as Ellias's daughter who lives in Great Falls and works in health care administration, and says the family talks by phone and video. Q11 says Ruth or Lena may help with heavy cleaning before visitors. Q42 says Ellias trusts his daughter for vaccine information because she works around health care. Q46 says Lena is busy and stretched.

social_circle.name: Thomas Chand

demographics.education: High school diploma with vocational maintenance training

background.how_they_met: Thomas is Ellias and Mary's adult son, raised in their family household in Havre.
background.why_close: Thomas shares Ellias's hands-on practical skills and family obligations. Though he lives farther away in Billings and visits less often than Lena, he remains part of regular family calls and planning.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Brief texts, often one or two lines. He is more likely to answer directly than start long emotional conversations, and he may use photos of repair projects or the kids instead of long explanations.

shared_activities: family conversations about race, policing, and safety
recent_text_topics: Planning his next trip from Billings and whether the grandchildren can visit during summer or a holiday.
School maintenance work stories, tools, weather, and practical repair advice.
Checking on Ellias's arthritis flare and whether he is still avoiding heavy lifting and ladder work.
Family conversations about younger relatives, policing, and being watched or stopped on the road.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q05 identifies Thomas as Ellias's son in Billings doing maintenance work for a school district and says they talk by phone and video. Q19 says Ellias hears about grandchildren's school routines from Lena and Thomas. Q30 says Thomas is more cautious about race and policing because of experiences being watched in stores or stopped on the road.

social_circle.name: Ruth Chand

demographics.occupation: Part-time elder care aide and small-scale egg seller

background.how_they_met: Ruth is Ellias's younger sister; they grew up together in Havre with their parents and brother Calvin.
background.why_close: They live near each other, see one another about weekly, share childhood history, tease each other, and help with family and household needs.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Friendly, informal texts with teasing. She sends quick updates, practical questions, and occasional photos, often about eggs, suppers, weather, or relatives.

recent_text_topics: Whether she is dropping off eggs and whether Ellias and Mary need anything from outside town.
Community supper plans and who from the family or tribal community will be there.
Helping Mary and Ellias with heavy cleaning before summer visitors arrive.
Family updates about cousins, elders, appointments, and local weather.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q06 says Ellias has a younger sister, Ruth, outside Havre, that they are close and see each other usually once a week, often at community supper or when she drops off eggs. Q11 says Ruth or Lena may help with heavy cleaning before visitors. Q99 says Ellias lived with Ruth and Calvin when he was young.

social_circle.name: Joe Whitehorse

demographics.occupation: Retired road maintenance worker and senior walking club member

background.how_they_met: They likely became close through the senior walking club, river trail walks, and the Havre-area Native and arts community. The interview names Joe as Ellias's regular Wednesday walking companion and emotional support friend.
background.why_close: Joe provides steady male friendship, walking accountability, humor, baseball talk, and direct advice when Ellias is struggling.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Short, direct texts with teasing and practical check-ins. He may use sentence fragments, baseball references, and blunt encouragement rather than long emotional messages.

shared_activities: Wednesday walks on the river trail
recent_text_topics: Confirming Wednesday river trail walks and whether weather or icy paths require a shorter loop.
Baseball talk, including the Billings Mustangs and old favorite players.
Checking on Ellias after the right-hand arthritis flare and joking that he should quit trying to be 40.
Grandchildren updates and old community troubles they discuss after walking.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q07 says Ellias's friend Joe Whitehorse meets him most Wednesdays after walking the river trail and they talk baseball, grandchildren, and old community troubles. Q07 also says Ellias calls Mary first and Joe if he needs 'a man's plain talk.' Q32 says social support helps because Ellias will walk farther if Joe is expecting him. Q44 says Ellias talked with Joe after a rough stretch with his hand.
